note: TRAI LSA 'Andhra Pradesh' covers residual AP and Telangana (PIR Table 1.42 note 2)
Delhi LSA also covers NCR towns in Haryana/UP (Gurugram/Faridabad/Noida/Ghaziabad) for some operators
Maharashtra LSA includes Goa and EXCLUDES Mumbai
Mumbai metro LSA (Mumbai/Navi Mumbai/Thane/Kalyan) is part of Maharashtra state
Tamil Nadu LSA includes Chennai (and Puducherry)
Kolkata metro LSA is part of West Bengal
West Bengal LSA includes Sikkim and A&N Islands
